deferral_rationale: Reconciler binding severity downgrade BLOCKER->CONCERN (round-1 tie-break). Module verified correct (15/15 tests executed by Claude reviewer and re-executed by reconciler, 2.95s). The 0.5s negative waits at tests/test_background_upload.py:263/:356 ARE the decisive still-blocked witnesses, but a broken implementation is caught with probability ~1 per run (false-PASS requires a >=0.5s descheduling of a runnable helper thread coinciding with the regression; no false-FAIL direction exists). Plan v2's own A8 registered wording ('assert the joining caller has NOT returned') structurally requires a negative witness and the plan nowhere specifies the instrumented-entry alternative, so the realized shape is a defensible reading of 'bounded waits assert event ordering, never elapsed ms'. Deterministic strengthening is cheap and concrete; re-raised at CONCERN under the same id.
